quotes.quote: Be not afraid of greatness. Some are born great, some achieve greatness, and others have greatness thrust upon them.
quotes.author: William Shakespeare,  Twelfth Night

quotes.quote: When I was young, my ambition was to be one of the people who made a difference in this world. My hope is to leave the world a little better for having been there.
quotes.author: Jim Henson

quotes.quote: Ambition is the path to success. Persistence is the vehicle you arrive in.
quotes.author: Bill Bradley

quotes.quote: Keep away from people who try to belittle your ambitions. Small people always do that, but the really great make you feel that you, too, can become great.
quotes.author: Mark Twain

quotes.quote: I'm hopeful. I know there is a lot of ambition in Washington, obviously. But I hope the ambitious realize that they are more likely to succeed with success as opposed to failure.
quotes.author: George W. Bush

quotes.quote: Whatever success I may have attained is due to the fact that since I was old enough to work at all, my ambition has never deserted me.
quotes.author: Anna Held

quotes.quote: For instance, on the planet Earth, man had always assumed that he was more intelligent than dolphins because he had achieved so much--the wheel, New York, wars and so on--whilst all the dolphins had ever done was muck about in the water having a good time. But conversely, the dolphins had always believed that they were far more intelligent than man--for precisely the same reasons.
quotes.author: Douglas Adams,  The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy

quotes.quote: My ambition is handicapped by laziness
quotes.author: Charles Bukowski,  Factotum

quotes.quote: Women who seek to be equal with men lack ambition.
quotes.author: Timothy Leary

quotes.quote: Being kind is the most important thing I've ever been taught. That's what my parents always told me - more important than ambition or success is being kind to people. The cornerstone of my life. What I aspire to is to be kind.
quotes.author: Rafe Spall

quotes.quote: Nothing great in the world was accomplished without passion.
quotes.author: Georg Wilhelm Friedrich Hegel

quotes.quote: You can only become truly accomplished at something you love. Don't make money your goal. Instead pursue the things you love doing and then do them so well that people can't take their eyes off of you.
quotes.author: Maya Angelou

quotes.quote: Ally."Peeta says the words slowly, tasting it. "Friend. Lover. Victor. Enemy. Fiancee. Target. Mutt. Neighbor. Hunter. Tribute. Ally. I'll add it to the list of words I use to try to figure you out. The problem is, I can't tell what's real anymore, and what's made up.
quotes.author: Suzanne Collins,  Mockingjay

quotes.quote: There was no harm in taking aim, even if the target was a dream.
quotes.author: John Knowles,  A Separate Peace

quotes.quote: One needs more than ambition and talent to make a success of anything, really. There must be love and a vocation.
quotes.author: Jessye Norman

quotes.quote: You cannot kill a breeze, a wind, a fragrance; you cannot kill a dream or an ambition.
quotes.author: Michel Onfray

quotes.quote: The desire to reach for the stars is ambitious. The desire to reach hearts is wise.
quotes.author: Maya Angelou

quotes.quote: I have a personal ambition to live my life honestly and honor the true love that I've had and also the people I've had around me. I want to stay hopeful, even though I get scared about why we're even alive at all.
quotes.author: Lana Del Rey

quotes.quote: Ambition is the path to success, persistence is the vehicle you arrive in.
quotes.author: William Eardley IV

quotes.quote: Failure is only postponed success as long as courage 'coaches' ambition. The habit of persistence is the habit of victory.
quotes.author: Herbert Kaufman

quotes.quote: Drugs are the enemies of ambition and hope - and when we fight against drugs we are fighting for the future.
quotes.author: Bob Riley

quotes.quote: Get going. Move forward. Aim High. Plan a takeoff. Don't just sit on the runway and hope someone will come along and push the airplane. It simply won't happen. Change your attitude and gain some altitude. Believe me, you'll love it up here.
quotes.author: Donald J. Trump

quotes.quote: She is free in her wildness, she is a wanderess, a drop of free water. She knows nothing of borders and cares nothing for rules or customs. 'Time' for her isn't something to fight against. Her life flows clean, with passion, like fresh water.
quotes.author: Roman Payne

quotes.quote: I'm not a very good sleeper. But you know what? I'm willing to put in a few extra hours every day to get better. That's just the kind of hard worker I am.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  Whenever You're Gone, I'm Here For You

quotes.quote: You must give everything to make your life as beautiful as the dreams that dance in your imagination.
quotes.author: Roman Payne

quotes.quote: Your fantasies define you, so dream carefully. A man with no imagination is a man with no future in today's world--and no past in tomorrow's.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: As long as I am breathing, in my eyes, I am just beginning.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: I got my degree. More importantly, I got a key to American opportunity. That's who we are - a nation that rewards ambition with opportunity. Where hard work can lead to success, no matter where you start.
quotes.author: Eva Longoria

quotes.quote: I was an adventurer, but she was not an adventuress. She was a 'wanderess.' Thus, she didn't care about money, only experiences - whether they came from wealth or from poverty, it was all the same to her.
quotes.author: Roman Payne,  The Wanderess

quotes.quote: Persistence. Perfection. Patience. Power. Prioritize your passion. It keeps you sane.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: There is a loftier ambition than merely to stand high in the world. It is to stoop down and lift mankind a little higher.
quotes.author: Henry Van Dyke

quotes.quote: Find a purpose to serve, not a lifestyle to live.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Venus in Arms

quotes.quote: Because there was a hunger in me to see everything and do everything. I wanted to be everyone I saw. I wasn't enough for me. Can you understand that?
quotes.author: Sidney Sheldon,  Bloodline

quotes.quote: The biggest changes in a women's nature are brought by love; in man, by ambition
quotes.author: Rabindranath Tagore

quotes.quote: Why do I do anything?' she says. 'I'm educated enough to talk myself out of any plan. To deconstruct any fantasy. Explain away any goal. I'm so smart I can negate any dream.
quotes.author: Chuck Palahniuk,  Choke

quotes.quote: If a person holds no ambitions in this world, he suffers unknowingly. If a person holds ambitions, he suffers knowingly, but very slowly.
quotes.author: Alan Lightman,  Einstein's Dreams

quotes.quote: People will kill you. Over time. They will shave out every last morsel of fun in you with little, harmless sounding phrases that people uses every day, like: 'Be realistic!'"[What It Is (2009)]
quotes.author: Dylan Moran

quotes.quote: Never give up. It's like breathing--once you quit, your flame dies letting total darkness extinguish every last gasp of hope. You can't do that. You must continue taking in even the shallowest of breaths, continue putting forth even the smallest of efforts to sustain your dreams. Don't ever, ever, ever give up.
quotes.author: Richelle E. Goodrich,  Smile Anyway: Quotes, Verse, & Grumblings for Every Day of the Year

quotes.quote: I would not sit waiting for some vague tomorrow, nor for something to happen. One could wait a lifetime, and find nothing at the end of the waiting. I would begin here, I would make something happen.
quotes.author: Louis L'Amour,  Sackett's Land

quotes.quote: When she was a child, my love carried a road-map in her hand the way other girls carried handkerchiefs. She always knew the way. Her feet were little wings. And her beautiful head was a compass.
quotes.author: Roman Payne

quotes.quote: Too many people out there tell us what we can and cannot do but...they don't know who we are, what's put in us.
quotes.author: Alex Rogers,  I'm Only Human After All

quotes.quote: Live for each second without hesitation
quotes.author: Elton John

quotes.quote: It doesn't matter how great your shoes are if you don't accomplish anything in them.
quotes.author: Martina Boone,  Compulsion

quotes.quote: Those with less curiosity or ambition just mumble that God works in mysterious ways. I intend to catch him in the act.
quotes.author: Damien Echols,  Life After Death

quotes.quote: Remember how far you've come, and you won't have to rely on a destiny for your future. It will come on your own.
quotes.author: Shannon A. Thompson,  Seconds Before Sunrise

quotes.quote: He believed in himself, believed in his quixotic ambition, letting the failures of the previous day disappear as each new day dawned. Yesterday was not today. The past did not predict the future if he could learn from his mistakes.
quotes.author: Daniel Wallace,  The Kings and Queens of Roam

quotes.quote: There are two goddesses in your heard. The Goddess of Wisdom and the Goddess of Wealth. Everyone thinks they need to get wealth first, and wisdom will come. So they concern themselves with chasing money. But they have it backwards. You have to give your heart to the Goddess of Wisdom, giver her all your love and attention, and the Goddess of Wealth will become jealous, and follow you.
quotes.author: Joe Vigil

quotes.quote: The difference between greed and ambition is a greedy person desires things he isn't prepared to work for.
quotes.author: Habeeb Akande

quotes.quote: ...you're either gonna spend your life fucking pussy, or taking it to church.
quotes.author: Dave Matthes,  Bar Nights

quotes.quote: Do not let your grand ambitions stand in the way of small but meaningful accomplishments.
quotes.author: Bryant McGill

quotes.quote: To ask, 'How do you do it?' is already starting off on the wrong foot. When reaching for the stars, there does not have to be a 'how' if there is a big enough 'why'.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Diotima, Battery, Electric Personality

quotes.quote: The power of hope! Even a lack of ambition can, for a time, pay off as a necessary facet, as long as hope outweighs it.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: Ambition is not what a man would do, but what a man does, for ambition without action is fantasy.
quotes.author: Bryant McGill

quotes.quote: Women show men beauty in things beyond their ambitions. Women tell men to stop and smell the roses.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Diotima, Battery, Electric Personality

quotes.quote: A brick could make everything better for me. Now, if I could only find a way to get my hands on one. But it's a silly dream, because I don't have the ambition to get out from under my blanket and go out and grab the very thing I most desire.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  A brick and a blanket walk into a bar

quotes.quote: Whatever your passion is, keep doing it. Don't waste time chasing after success or comparing yourself to others. Every flower blooms at a different pace. Excel at doing what your passion is and only focus on perfecting it. Eventually people will see what you are great at doing, and if you are truly great, success will come chasing after you.
quotes.author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

quotes.quote: You will never know how high you can climb until you reach the top.
quotes.author: K.L. Toth

quotes.quote: The truest of all truths is this: You are a child of God. Out of more than six billion people on earth now, He knows your name, what you fear and what you revere. He cares about the things you care about. He wants your happiness and success, and will reach to the farthest corner of the universe to see that you obtain your noblest dreams.
quotes.author: Toni Sorenson

quotes.quote: Every flower blooms at a different pace.
quotes.author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

quotes.quote: People need not fear the unknown if they have a capable of achieving what they need and what
quotes.author: Paulo Coelho

quotes.quote: If life throws you a few bad notes or vibrations, don't let them interrupt or alter your song.
quotes.author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

quotes.quote: Pursue your dreams. You will be amazed about what you can achieve.
quotes.author: Lailah Gifty Akita,  Pearls of Wisdom: Great mind

quotes.quote: The possibility of the dream gives strength.
quotes.author: Lailah Gifty Akita,  Pearls of Wisdom: Great mind

quotes.quote: There's sometimes a tugging feeling you get to push further when you aren't being challenged enough or when things get too comfortable.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: Whatever you dream of, there will be fulfillment.
quotes.author: Lailah Gifty Akita,  Pearls of Wisdom: Great mind

quotes.quote: Don't aim at success--the more you aim at it and make it a target, the more you are going to miss it.
quotes.author: Viktor E. Frankl,  Man's Search for Meaning

quotes.quote: The petty man wants to use God for himself; the ambitious man wants God to use him for God.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Healology

quotes.quote: We can live forever even with an impactful shorter-life.
quotes.author: Aniekee Tochukwu Ezekiel,  Psychology of Friendship for Leadership
